items.title: Netflix Is Down 46% From Its High. Is This a Once-in-a-Lifetime Buying Opportunity Before the Stock Goes Parabolic?
items.summary: Netflix's stock has taken a beating, but with the ad business growing and big buybacks underway, this could be a pretty attractive entry point for long-term investors.

items.title: DUOL Stock Rises Premarket: Analyst Sees ‘Netflix-Like’ Growth Scenario, Doubles Price Target
items.summary: Evercore ISI analyst Mark Mahaney upgraded Duolingo to ‘Outperform’ from ‘In Line’ with a price target of $210, up from $105, as per TheFly.

items.title: GOOGL Stock Delivers Like The Leader, Priced Like The Laggard
items.summary: In a group of tech giants, one company delivers top-tier growth but wears the group's lowest price tag, forcing investors to decide if it's a bargain or a warning sign.

items.title: Duolingo Stock Gets an Upgrade. This Analyst Sees a Netflix-Like Comeback.
items.summary: Duolingo’s latest results showed that users are still flocking to the app. Second-quarter revenue rose 18% from a year earlier.

items.title: Netflix vs. Meta: The Better Media Stock May Surprise You
items.summary: Netflix and Meta both reported strong revenue growth in Q2 2026, yet the market punished both stocks hard. One of them is now setting up as a surprisingly calm compounder while the other bets everything on a $140 billion AI wager.

items.title: Jim Cramer Calls Netflix “A Buy, Not a Huge Buy” After Shares Fall 35% in a Year
items.summary: A longtime Netflix shareholder put Jim Cramer on the spot after watching shares lose more than a third of their value, and his answer about whether to hold, add, or sell reveals just how conflicted even the bulls have become.

items.title: The Bull Case for Netflix Stock Is Stronger Than You Think
items.summary: Netflix stock is down more than 30% over the past year while the business keeps growing revenue at double digits, and that disconnect is exactly what has one major billionaire investor stepping back in.
